versions.changelog:
Xiaoyuzhou (小宇宙) podcast support added and subtitle workflows introduced.

- Added support for capturing 小宇宙（Xiaoyuzhou）podcast links, including parsing of shared text and extracting/using URL timestamps.
- Implemented subtitle download, parsing, and time window filtering for Xiaoyuzhou episodes with available SRT/VTT.
- Workflows for Xiaoyuzhou now include:
  - Subtitle availability checks, download, and parsing.
  - Deep summary generation based on user-specified time point windows or full transcript.
  - User-facing notifications if subtitles are unavailable or ASR is not configured.
- Updated supported platform list and documentation to reflect Xiaoyuzhou integration.
- Added corresponding scripts (xiaoyuzhou.ts and test-xiaoyuzhou.ts) for new platform handling.

linkmind-capture 0.2.0

- Added support for extracting and transcribing video/audio content via a new transcript extraction script.
- Integrated new scripts: `extract-transcript.ts` and `test-transcript.ts` for handling multimedia transcripts.
- Updated workflows to use a unified `--media-url` parameter for transcript extraction.
- Extended the skill documentation with detailed steps for transcript extraction and error handling.
- Refined types and configuration handling to support audio/video processing.

- Improved WeChat article image handling: after downloading images, Markdown `richContent` now uses local image paths and inserts per-image analysis blockquotes immediately after each image.
- Clarified workflow: explicitly detail how to substitute image URLs in `richContent` and integrate multimodal analysis for WeChat.
- No changes to core supported platforms or triggers.
- Documentation updated for greater precision in image processing steps.

- Added support for capturing and summarizing WeChat Official Account (mp.weixin.qq.com) articles.
- New scripts: `wechat.ts` for WeChat extraction and `test-wechat.ts` for testing.
- Documentation and workflows updated: all features now explicitly support Weibo, Xiaohongshu, and WeChat links.
- ASR/video transcript and credentials configuration instructions clarified for `.env`.
- Improved platform identification, error messaging, and setup instructions for new platform support.

- Adds an interactive setup wizard (`npm run setup`) for guided configuration of the Obsidian vault path, platform cookies, and ASR credentials.
- Updates the configuration instructions: users are now prompted to run the setup wizard instead of manually copying and editing the config template.
- Introduces a new setup script: `scripts/setup.ts`.
- Improves documentation in SKILL.md to reflect streamlined onboarding and configuration changes.

LinkMind v0.1.0 — initial release

- Capture and extract content from Weibo and Xiaohongshu social media links.
- Save extracted text, images, and metadata as a Markdown note in your Obsidian vault.
- Download images for offline access, including optional AI-powered content analysis for each image.
- If enabled, supports AI video transcription and includes transcript in Markdown output.
- Automatic YAML-safe metadata handling and organized attachment storage.
- Supports both Chinese and English trigger phrases for fast content capture.
